cases.title: Each widening needs re-approval
cases.when: Profile pairs: new destination, new route, /orders/{id:[0-9]+} to /orders/{path:.*}, new query name, new header name, larger limits, streaming on, different credential, TLS pin removed, redirects allowed, longer timeout, new method, new content type

cases.title: Narrowing is shown but needs no re-approval
cases.when: The reverse of each widening pair
then: Every pair classifies as NARROWING and is shown in review

cases.title: A change the classifier cannot classify counts as widening
cases.when: A pattern change the classifier cannot compare (two unrelated regexes)

cases.title: Some changes are always a security delta
cases.when: Changes: CREDENTIALS_IN_SANDBOX added, UNKNOWN to IDEMPOTENT, businessKeyNamespace changed, a host setting changed

cases.title: The broker loads the profile by the permit digest
cases.when: A profile is widened and approved while an invocation holding the old digest runs
then: The running invocation uses the old profile
New permits carry the new digest

cases.title: Library tools cannot be widened by the host
cases.when: A host package re-declares a library route with a broader pattern
